ei.title: Seeing the Extraordinary in the Ordinary

fullPassage:
Stentzel is perhaps best known for her Clothesline Animals series.

(A) Other creations followed, including a brown cow standing on some hills and a zebra crossing the desert. All of these works were created from nothing more than laundry and household items.

(B) She got inspiration for the series while she was hanging her laundry. By simply adding some colorful clothespins and a dish towel, she was able to transform her black sweatshirt and dark grey pants into a horse.

(C) Another series that highlights Stentzel's astonishing creativity is Edible Creatures. For this series, she arranges food items you can find in any kitchen to create cute animals.

questions.passage: Look at these two paintings. Believe it or not, they both ⓐ depict the same person, Holy Roman Emperor Rudolf II. Created by a 16th-century Italian painter ⓑ named Giuseppe Arcimboldo, the painting shows striking creativity and originality. Fruits, flowers, and vegetables ⓒ are arranged like the pieces of a puzzle to create a human head. He used plants, animals, and other objects to create many other portraits ⓓ like this. Another good example of Arcimboldo's unique creativity can ⓔ find in The Gardener, one of his "reversible" paintings.

questions.passage: Creativity. When you hear this word, what instantly pops into your mind? You may think it is a quality that only artists and writers possess — some special talent you are either born with or without. Many people accept the idea that we can be divided into two groups: those who are creative and those who are not. This common belief, however, is far from the truth. Everyone has the ability to be creative. Finding creativity inside yourself just takes a little effort.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 지문의 내용과 문맥을 분석하면 the belief that everyone has creative ability가 정답이다. 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
det.analysis:
❌ ① the difference between artists and ordinary people: 지문의 내용과 불일치하거나 근거 부족
❌ ② why only talented people can be creative: 지문의 내용과 불일치하거나 근거 부족
✅ ③ the belief that everyone has creative ability: 지문의 내용에 부합하는 정답
❌ ④ the history of creative art movements: 지문의 내용과 불일치하거나 근거 부족
❌ ⑤ how ordinary objects are made in factories: 지문의 내용과 불일치하거나 근거 부족
det.tip: 내용 이해 — 지문의 핵심 주제와 세부 내용을 꼼꼼히 읽으세요.
